svg.aria-label: ExamGen AI — Education SaaS · LLM backend
svg.title: ExamGen AI — Education SaaS · LLM backend
svg.desc: FastAPI backend that turns a syllabus into a complete exam with an LLM: questions, answer key and rubric, exported as student and teacher PDFs. JWT auth, per-user authorization in every query, subscription gating.
